name: TSU IBANO
detail: Hon'no gijutsu. Not a blast -- a stabilizing field. Short, unremarkable normals, but his special enforces baseline reality hard enough to floor anything standing in it. Lean and unhurried; the only fighter here who answers pressure rather than applying it.

name: FEI YOUNG
detail: Taijutsu only. "I can't cast a gijutsu, but I can damn sure punch one." Longer reach and heavier normals, no projectile, and the best approach speed in the slice. Where Tsu answers pressure, Fei applies it.

name: RYU (fixture)
detail: The vendored engine's own reference fighter, kept as the regression fixture the M0 and M1 verification scenes run against. Not a Project Cerberus character.
